reviewItem.question: Does "A. (Preferred) Enable the WAL and rely on the new ingester to replay the WAL" mean a change to migration:loki|name=wal-enablement-for-max-transfer-retries-removal (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 recommends enabling WAL and optionally enabling flush_on_shutdown to handle the removal of max_transfer_retries configuration.
